sloka: पुण्यैः च नियत आहारैः शोभितम् परम ऋषिभिः ।तत् ब्रह्म भवन प्रख्यम् ब्रह्म घोष निनादितम् ॥३-१-८॥
transliteration: puṇyaiḥ ca niyata āhāraiḥ śobhitam parama ṛṣibhiḥ ।tat brahma bhavana prakhyam brahma ghoṣa nināditam ॥3-1-8॥

translations.english: The hermitages echoing with the sounds of Vedic recitations and resembling the very abode of Brahma were adorned with great, holy sages living on regulated diet.
